findings.title: Preserve HTTP failure status in paginated CallAPI responses
findings.scenario: Page1 returns HTTP200 with one item, has_more:true and next token; page2 returns HTTP500 or403 with valid JSON {} or code:0. CallAPI drops StatusCode; paginateLoop treats the page as success/exhaustion, and mergePagedResults emits the earlier prefix with has_more:false. Generated JSON/page-all can publish and save a falsely complete artifact; NDJSON exits successfully after a partial stream. A first error page is also accepted.
findings.evidence: SDK v3.7.2 core/httptransport.go doSend returns ApiResp for these HTTP statuses (504 alone is special); internal/client/response.go HandleResponse already rejects HTTP errors with no nonzero business code. Existing pagination_e2e covers a nonzero business code only.
findings.requested_change: Reject HTTP errors in CallAPI while retaining nonzero business-code diagnostics; add first/later error-page regressions for valid JSON with missing/zero code and no successful aggregate/artifact.

findings.title: Exclude unified OAuth token acquisition from content receipts
findings.scenario: A bot write with no cached TAT uses FetchTAT via Factory.HttpClient at accounts host /oauth/v3/token. Only legacy /open-apis auth prefixes are bypassed. Token acquisition is therefore treated as content mutation: standard access_token response without code becomes durable unknown and forces exit22 even after a successful business write; a code:0 token response still creates a false content receipt. Before identity resolution it can fail the mutation identity precondition.
findings.evidence: internal/credential/tat_fetch.go FetchTAT builds endpoint from core.OAuthTokenV3Path; factory_default.go wraps direct credential client in agentAttemptTransport. TestAgentAttemptsReadAndAuthDoNotResolveCredentials covers only legacy token paths. Artifact lifecycle token tests use a custom unwrapped client and do not exercise this integration.
findings.requested_change: Bypass the exact unified token endpoint before account/receipt resolution and add a cold-TAT real Factory transport regression proving only the business request creates a receipt.
